probe_stdout: CONFIRMED — actual: edges keys are non-string tuples ["('greeter__hello__0', 'greeter-erl')"] | expected: every edges key is the single canonicalized FQN string, e.g. 'greeter__hello__0'
trigger_summary: Analyzing any project containing at least one Erlang file with a detected function makes _analyze_project_uncached return an ErlangAnalysis whose .edges keys are (function_id, caller_module) tuples instead of the spec-required single canonicalized FQN string, so consumers indexing edges by function-id string miss every caller.
